# Multiavatar (vendored)

Matrundan vendors the ESM build from `multiavatar/Multiavatar` package version 1.0.7
for deterministic, local SVG avatar generation. The vendored generator is used only
as an avatar feature inside Matrundan and no seed or personal data is sent to an
external avatar service.

Source: https://github.com/multiavatar/Multiavatar
Upstream file: `dist/esm/index.js`
License: Multiavatar License v1.0 (see `LICENSE` in this directory).
